mongoose_server_selection_details.message: Could not connect to any servers in your MongoDB Atlas cluster.

analysis: The URI matches the exact standard format, and 'family: 6' successfully forces IPv6 DNS resolution. Node.js resolves the IPs and adds all 3 servers to the Topology Map. However, their state remains 'Unknown' with no explicit socket errors. In Mongoose 8.x/driver 6.x, when TCP connects (no ECONNREFUSED/ETIMEDOUT) but the server state remains Unknown without a socket error, it usually indicates that the initial MongoDB wire-protocol handshake (the 'hello' or 'isMaster' command) was rejected by the server due to an authentication failure (invalid credentials or a password requiring URL-encoding). The driver fails to transition the servers from Unknown to a known replica set state.
